source_question: Which exact contract does this subject demonstrably conform to, and under which evidence?
source_effect: Records scoped conformance only; it does not imply admission, implementation conformance outside scope, or runtime conformance.

independent_meaning.state_parameter: W: independently defined typed semantic world and owned catalogs
common_constraints: Exact kind/source definition and approved meaning revision.
Exact source/target node kinds and revisions match one declared ordered pair.
Every required qualifier has its independently defined typed interpretation; closed qualifier object has no extra field.
Primary witness, subject, target, context, scope, source snapshot, epoch and time domain agree with the complete frame.
The selected evidence and provenance policy establishes the claimed recorded/as-of/executed/observed posture; missing authenticity is not manufactured.
kind_specific_constraints: An accepted conformance assessment has subject s, target t and the literal conformance_scope in f.
exact_version_ref denotes t; the evidence reference resolves to exact admissible support under the selected policy.
Each ordered pair has its own target criterion interpretation: contract, governed-model or context-profile. Context-to-profile uses the exact declared context projection.
Legacy F0 literal-token meaning is retained in its original profile; the new typed profile has an explicit mapping and stronger owner/provenance requirements.

operational_effect.meaning: Record scoped snapshot conformance to this exact target; do not infer current runtime behavior, effectiveness or admission.
operational_effect.record_delta: Append one exact immutable witnessed relation record, or idempotently retain an identical existing revision; same revision with different content is refused.
operational_effect.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_effect.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.

worked_failure: An assessment for another target profile cannot support conformance to this one.
source_refinement_contract: Under exact owned catalog/frame well-formedness, decoding and resolution of raw source fields yields a iff the independently specified source constraints denote Meaning_K10(W,a). The decoder/checker must not define that source predicate.
proof_contract: Prove the independent meaning has a valid positive model.
Prove each exact qualifier mapping and checker/meaning equivalence.
Prove declared record effect and any required execution/closure preservation.
Check each kind-scoped non-entailment countermodel under the complete pinned theory.
Account for all declared ordered pairs and prove role-sensitive branches; one positive example per kind is insufficient.
approval_scope_note: The prior receipt, if present, retains its exact earlier scope. It does not accept this expanded batch revision, global policies or proofs.
formal_expression: Meaning_K10(W,e,f) := f.profile = typedSuccessor ∧ ∃ w ∈ W.ScopedConformance. Base_K10(W,e,f,w) ∧ (w.subject = s ∧ w.target = t ∧ t = resolve(q.exact_version_ref) ∧ w.scope = scopeValue(q.conformance_scope) ∧ w.evidence = evidenceValue(q.conformance_evidence_refs) ∧ ScopedCriteriaSatisfied(W,w,f))

notation.W: independently supplied typed semantic world, exact captured bodies and owner catalogs; not checker output
notation.e: candidate edge with kind, exact source s, exact target t and closed raw qualifiers q
notation.f: complete exact evaluation frame and selected meaning/evidence/digest/catalog profiles
notation.q: e.qualifiers; precisely the required fields listed below
notation.w: independent normalized primary witness record, with the following typed roles

witness_fields.subject: Capability Instance or Context exact revision
witness_fields.target: Contract, Governed Model or Context Profile exact revision
witness_fields.scope: literal F0 scope or explicitly mapped successor scope
witness_fields.evidence: literal F0 support reference or successor evidence-reference collection
witness_fields.criteria: complete owned target criteria for the selected pair/profile

special_atoms.resolve: The unique entry for the raw token in the selected immutable typed reference catalog for this relation, pair, field and frame. Missing, ambiguous or wrong-kind entries are undefined and cannot establish Meaning.
special_atoms.scopeValue: Legacy F0 selects its original exact literal-token denotation; the successor selects an explicit owned scope-catalog mapping. Profile selection is part of the meaning revision and cannot silently widen the legacy interpretation.
special_atoms.evidenceValue: Legacy F0 uses its original literal evidence-reference meaning; the successor resolves an exact bounded reference collection with declared multiplicity/duplicate policy. A string is not implicitly split into a list.
special_atoms.ScopedCriteriaSatisfied: In successor mode the complete owned criterion derivation for this exact pair/target/scope has a yes verdict for every active mandatory criterion and no unresolved potential/conflicting required criterion. D05 determines verdicts from admissible exact evidence. Legacy F0 retains its pinned original any-accepted-positive-support predicate, separately indexed by profile.

base_definition: Base requires exact selected kind/meaning revision; membership of this ordered pair in the pinned signature; independently captured endpoint revisions; exactly the declared qualifier fields with unique typed catalog interpretation; primary witness source/target joins and frame agreement; and provenance sufficient for the declared claim tier. It never invokes the relation checker. Undefined resolution cannot establish Meaning.

plain_language_intuition.text: Conformance establishes the owned criteria for a particular subject, target and scope in a supplied snapshot. A later runtime state requires a new assessment.

operational_interpretation.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_interpretation.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.
operational_interpretation.record_postcondition: R_after = R_before ∪ {exactRecord(e,w,f)} for a new row; identical retry leaves R unchanged; same record identity with different content refuses atomically.
operational_interpretation.meaning_world_preserved: W_after = W_before; appending the relation log alone does not execute its witness, change authority roots or replace active artifacts.
operational_interpretation.composed_closure_status: Full-rule/composed-state preservation remains a separate theorem target; append-only local behavior does not prove it.

worked_cases.positive: Context C meets Profile P at epoch 5 under its exact assessment; a later source change can invalidate live reuse.
worked_cases.insufficient: An assessment for another target profile cannot support conformance to this one.
worked_cases.correction: Provide admissible support for every owned applicable criterion of this target and scope; preserve the legacy F0 profile when using its literal tokens.

source_refinement_gap: Three different target semantics need separate bridges. Existing F0 evidence strings remain literal; successor lists and negative evidence must use a new explicit profile.

theorem_targets.assumption_note: CompleteOwnedInputs and WF must be independently justified. These are proposed targets, not new theorem declarations or inherited discharges.

profile_contract.typed_successor: The stronger independent Meaning here is available only in an explicitly selected typedSuccessor profile.
profile_contract.legacy_claim_ceiling: Exact original literal-token/accepted-assessment predicate. An accepted flag or nonempty literal remains supplied graph data; it is not authenticated source truth or actual application.
profile_contract.bridge_obligation: Preserve legacy acceptance in its separately named/profile-indexed API. Do not rename LegacyQualified as the stronger Meaning, or infer typed-successor evidence, enum restrictions, execution or criteria completion from legacy acceptance.
